description: Interactive Tier 1 test plan. Sets the Immerse FX through three states (EHM-on-personalized, HeadphoneEq selected, EHM-on-universal) with operator-confirmed pauses between each. At every PAUSE: (a) open the Immerse plug-in UI in Wwise to visually verify the state, license info, etc., (b) CLOSE the plug-in UI before pressing Enter -- WAAPI rejects setProperty while the UI holds the object. Property values come from the Immerse plug-in XML: ConvolutionType {0=Universal, 1=Personalized}; HeadphoneEq enum includes 0=NONE, 102=Universal Closed Back, 26=Cloud Alpha, 104=Universal Open Back, etc.

scenarios.name: Step 1a: EHM ON (with current ConvType=Universal -> inMode:2)
Step 1b: ConvolutionType -> Personalized (1) -> inMode:1
scenarios.pauseMessage: Step 1 complete: EHM ON + Personalized. Open the Immerse plug-in UI in Wwise to verify user is loaded correctly (license type, profile name, etc). Then CLOSE the plug-in UI and press Enter to continue to Step 2 (HeadphoneEq).

scenarios.name: Step 2: HeadphoneEq -> Universal Closed Back (102)
scenarios.pauseMessage: Step 2 complete: HeadphoneEq set to 102 (Universal Closed Back). Open the Immerse plug-in UI to verify the HPEQ selection shows the chosen profile. Then CLOSE the UI and press Enter to continue to Step 3 (EHM Universal).

scenarios.name: Step 3: ConvolutionType -> Universal (0) -> inMode:2
scenarios.pauseMessage: Step 3 complete: EHM ON + Universal profile. Verify in the plug-in UI then CLOSE it and press Enter to finish the run (UE will be killed, results pushed).
